title: Rollback Rehearsal Evidence
description: Structured evidence that a rollback rehearsal was executed and confirmed working for a specific release.

releaseVersion.description: Semantic version of the release being deployed.

environment.description: Environment where the rollback rehearsal was executed.

strategy.description: Deployment strategy used for the release.

rehearsalDate.description: ISO 8601 date when the rehearsal was performed.

steps.description: Numbered rollback steps executed during the rehearsal.

maxRollbackTimeMinutes.description: Maximum allowed rollback time in minutes (rollback budget).

actualRollbackTimeMinutes.description: Actual time taken to complete the rollback in minutes.

withinBudget.description: Whether actual rollback time was within the budget.

witness.description: Person who witnessed and confirmed the rehearsal.

evidenceLinks.description: URLs to logs, metrics dashboards, or screenshots supporting the rehearsal.
